# Count occurrences of each total value
total_counts = df['total'].value_counts()
# Check if there is any total that appears more than two times
more_than_two = total_counts[total_counts > 2]
# The claim says "the only total that appears more than two times is 22"
# So we need to check two conditions:
# 1. The total 22 appears more than two times
# 2. No other total appears more than two times

# Condition 1: Check if 22 appears more than two times
condition1 = total_counts.get(22, 0) > 2

# Condition 2: Check if there are any totals other than 22 that appear more than two times
# Get all totals that appear more than two times
all_more_than_two = total_counts[total_counts > 2].index.tolist()
# Remove 22 if present
other_more_than_two = [x for x in all_more_than_two if x != 22]
condition2 = len(other_more_than_two) == 0

# Both conditions must be true for the claim to be true
answer = condition1 and condition2
